fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Three habits behind every Fieldnote release

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: We build a research tool, so we try to be the kind of team that uses one well.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: Two or three sentences that explain the idea.

default.title: Listen first
default.text: Every engineer joins two customer calls a month. Nobody writes a spec for a problem they have not heard a customer describe.

default.title: Share the raw words
default.text: We pass around clips, not summaries. A fifteen-second recording settles more debates than a page of notes.

default.title: Decide in the open
default.text: Roadmap calls happen in a shared doc with the evidence linked. Anyone can see why we chose what we chose.
